login.title: Sign In to Takerin
login.subtitle: Manage your paycheck allocations and track daily spending.

register.title: Sign Up for Takerin
register.subtitle: Start budgeting based on your monthly paycheck allocations.
register.termsNote: By creating an account, you agree to Takerin's terms of service and privacy policy.
register.successDesc: We have sent a verification link to {{email}}. Please check your inbox or spam folder to activate your account.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot Password?
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email address to receive password reset instructions.
forgotPassword.checkEmailDesc: If {{email}} is registered with Takerin, a password reset link has been sent to that address.

resetPassword.invalidDesc: This password reset link is invalid or the token was not found in URL parameters.
resetPassword.successDesc: Your Takerin account password has been updated. Please sign in with your new password.
resetPassword.title: Create New Password
resetPassword.subtitle: Enter a new password for your Takerin account.

twoFactor.otpDesc: Enter the 6-digit OTP code sent to your account email address.
twoFactor.backupDesc: Enter one of your backup codes to sign in to Takerin.

onboarding.welcomeSubtitle: Let's set up your income sources, pay date, and category allocations.
onboarding.step1Desc: Your Monthly Period will start on this date each month. If a month does not have this date (e.g. 31st in February), it adjusts automatically to the last day.
onboarding.payDayInputHelp: Enter a number between 1 and 31 according to your main income or salary cycle.
onboarding.step2Title: Where Does Your Income Come From?
onboarding.step2Desc: Add one or more regular monthly income sources (salary, commissions, freelance, business). This total forms the Monthly Income for your budget allocation.
onboarding.totalIncomeHelp: This total will be allocated into your monthly budget categories in the next step.
onboarding.step3Desc: Pick a starting point for your budget division. You can customize category names, percentages, or add/remove categories in the next step.
onboarding.step4Desc: Set names, percentage allocations, and mark savings categories. Total percentages must equal exactly 100%.
onboarding.allocationExact: ✓ Total percentage is exactly 100%. You're ready to use Takerin!
onboarding.allocationOver: Over by {{percent}}%. Total allocation cannot exceed 100%.

dashboard.overviewSubtitle: Overview of your active monthly budget allocation and financial tracking.
dashboard.categoryHelp: Budget allocation and remaining balance for each active category.
dashboard.noCategories: No categories connected to this monthly period yet.
dashboard.recentExpensesDesc: Expense records in this monthly period.
dashboard.noExpensesHelp: No expenses recorded in this period yet. Your full category balance is 100% intact.
dashboard.noExpensesYet: No expenses recorded in this period yet.
dashboard.aboutPeriodDesc: Budget cycle runs from {{startDate}} to {{endDate}}. Balances do not carry over to maintain disciplined monthly budgeting.
dashboard.accountSecurityDesc: User profile settings and two-factor authentication.
dashboard.warning80Desc: Your total expenses have reached {{percent}}% of Monthly Income ({{spent}} of {{total}}). Please manage daily expenses until your next payday.
dashboard.emptyPeriodDesc: You don't have an active monthly budget configuration. Set up your pay date and category allocations to begin.

expenses.title: Expense Transactions
expenses.subtitle: Track and manage all transactions in your active budget period
expenses.noExpenses: No expense transactions match your criteria.
expenses.newSubtitle: Enter expense details to instantly deduct from the category balance
expenses.deleteConfirmDesc: Are you sure you want to delete this expense? Category balance will be restored.

form.exceededWarning: Amount exceeds remaining balance for this category.

categories.title: Category Management
categories.subtitle: Manage allocation percentages for your budget and freeze categories if needed
categories.freezeTooltip: Frozen categories cannot receive new expense records
categories.deleteConfirmDesc: This category will be deleted from the active period. Ensure allocations are adjusted back to 100%.
categories.allocationRuleWarning: Total allocation percentage across all active categories must sum to 100%.

history.title: Budget Period History
history.subtitle: Review past financial performance and AI summaries from previous cycles
history.noHistoryDesc: Your current monthly budget period is still running. When your next pay date arrives, this cycle will complete automatically and appear here.
history.aiSummaryDesc: Smart summary analyzing spending habits, budget anomalies, and actionable next-cycle recommendations.
history.generatingAiSummary: AI is analyzing your period data...

settings.title: Account & Profile Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your profile, security, pay date, language, and data exports
settings.twoFactorDesc: Protect your account with an extra layer of security using an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.).
settings.backupCodesWarning: Keep these backup codes in a safe place. Each code can only be used once if you lose access to your authenticator app.
settings.payDayHelp: Can only be edited before 1 day prior to next active pay date.
settings.payDayLockedHelp: Pay date is locked because the active budget cycle is nearing completion.
settings.exportDesc: Export all transaction history to CSV or print a period summary to PDF.
settings.deleteDesc: This action cannot be undone. All your expenses, income, categories, and account will be permanently deleted.
settings.deleteModalWarning: WARNING: All your data in Cloudflare D1 will be permanently erased and cannot be recovered.
settings.deleteModalTypeConfirm: Type "HAPUS AKUN SAYA" below to confirm:

overview.title: Analytics Dashboard
overview.subtitle: Monitor key metrics on users, daily activity, total spending, and platform category trends.
overview.dauDesc: Active in the last 24 hours (session / login)
overview.top10Desc: Based on frequency of category names created by users

users.title: User Directory
users.subtitle: List of all registered users, onboarding progress, and recent activity. For financial privacy, expense details and balances are not displayed.
users.searchPlaceholder: Search by name or email address...
users.noUsersFound: No users match the search query "{{query}}".

templates.title: Category Templates
templates.subtitle: Manage budget category templates offered to users during onboarding.
templates.descPlaceholder: e.g., Proportional split for regular expenses...
templates.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete template {{name}}? It will no longer be available to new users in onboarding.

health.title: System Health
health.subtitle: Monitoring Cloudflare D1 capacity, AI service quota (Groq & Gemini), and Resend email status.
health.d1Limits: Cloudflare Free Tier limit: 5M reads/day, 100K writes/day, 5 GB storage.
health.aiFailover: Automatic failover for Monthly Summary (Groq ➔ Google Gemini).
health.groqPrivacy: Privacy: Only aggregated category percentages are sent
health.geminiFallback: Invoked when Groq times out or reaches quota limit
health.geminiPrivacy: Privacy: Zero raw financial transaction logs sent
health.resendDesc: Email verification, password resets, and 2FA OTP codes are sent via Resend API.
health.resendNote: Note: Resend does not provide a programmatic free endpoint to fetch real-time usage. Use the dashboard link above to view daily and monthly delivery charts.
